notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you so much for all the excitement and love for our clicker games. Your feedback is invaluable, and we’ve been hard at work improving both our current titles and those in development. Here’s a rundown of the latest updates we’ve implemented based on your suggestions:

Free Previous Goal Viewing: You can now view a previous goal at no cost, making it easier to revisit and strategize.
Clicks Per Second Display: We’ve added a CPS (Clicks Per Second) counter to the interface, so you can better track your progress.
New Translations: The game is now available in French, Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, and Russian. If you notice any inconsistencies, don’t hesitate to reach out to us directly!
Fun Chat Messages: Enjoy a series of amusing new messages in the game’s chat for a more entertaining experience.
Enhanced Click Visibility: Click rewards are now more noticeable, adding to the excitement of each click.
Improved Panel Controls: Buttons for hiding and showing panels are now more intuitive and user-friendly.

Bug Fixes: A handful of minor bugs have been addressed for smoother gameplay.
Once again, thank you for your continued support and feedback! We’re thrilled to hear your thoughts on these updates, so please keep sharing your ideas with us. Together, we’re making our games better than ever.

Happy clicking!

The Sexy Baguette Studio Team
